newsitem.title: UK: Medeva shares gain after R&D update.
newsitem.headline: Medeva shares gain after R&D update.

text.p: Shares in pharmaceutical company Medeva Plc were higher on Thursday after news that late stage trials of its Hepatitis B vaccine had been positive.
The shares were indicated 8p higher at 287-1/2p after adding 7p yesterday in anticipation of the drug development update.
Medeva's described the trial results for Hepagene and for a new chiral form of methylphenidate, as "encouraging".
The company also announced an alliance with Peptide Therapeutics for the transfer of part of Medeva's early stage product development.
Medeva plans to concentrate on late-stage drug development.
The company said it planned to file product licence applications for Hepagene in Europe and the U.S. in 1998.
Shares in Peptide were 36p higher at 277-1/2p by 0816 GMT.
